Subset: RGB/YCoCg conversion and optimized center-directed AABB clipping from
Assets/Shaders/TemporalReprojection.shader, ported to GLSL in
native/rhi/shaders/temporal_clipping.glsl. No Unity runtime dependency.
Adaptations: vec3 only, nonnegative RGB output without clipping HDR to one,
epsilon 1e-5. Camera reprojection and neighborhood integration belong to Astra.
